synthesis.body: A stdlib-only Python validator forces a documented subset (no $ref, no oneOf, etc.). The spec's AC needs to enumerate the subset; the plan's task Approach needs to enumerate it; the validator's module docstring needs to enumerate it. If any of the three drifts, a future agent extends one and not the others, and the next adversarial review surfaces it as a Blocker. Worth a single source of truth across docs + code from day one. Applies to any RFC where stdlib-only is a hard constraint and a subset of an external standard is the contract.

title: Document a JSON-Schema subset in spec + plan + validator docstring, all three in sync
